ownership.harn-llm: Canonical compact response-event tool-call projection and resolver, including six existing tests.
ownership.harn-orchestration: Training-example event parsing, state machine, pairing validation and output contracts.
ownership.harn-vm: Persisted run loading, execution identity and descriptor verification, filesystem access, then one typed call into the projector.

preserved_controls: Persisted transcript digest mismatch rejects edited sidecar bytes.
Wrong run, session, or execution identity rejects export.
Truncated terminal state, unpaired and reordered calls, unknown event versions, and conflicting response projections reject export.
Native and text-channel examples preserve exact served tool schemas and paired turns.
test_placement: The 27 existing Native projector unit cases become 25 public API integration cases plus two parser cases in the lower crate. Three additional lower-crate cases cover typed source provenance and session selection.
limits: These builds reused dependencies and are not cold-build measurements.
No hosted critical-path or ten-minute SLO improvement is claimed from this focused qualification.
Rust import paths and serialized values are retained, but defining-crate and type_name paths change as declared in the breaking-change fragment.
